page.layout: One page of running text, with the running head at the top centre. Below the text: the closing formula in italic, the closing word "Addictissimus," and the initials "S. G. S." set on separate lines. A small mark at the bottom centre. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: coque stylo conscriptam offero. Hunc autem
ordinem sequutus sum. Ad me pervenerunt
varia earundem prælectionum collectanea, præ-
cipue vero exemplar ab ornatiss. viro D. Ada-
mo Thobelski, C.T. præceptore, mihi liberali-
ter suppeditatum est, eius propria manu dili-
gentissimè, & Neostadii, paulo ante mortem
D. Vrsini, exceptum.Illo, meoque cum aliis
exemplaribus fideliter collatis, in hunc codi-
cem commentarios catecheticos D. Vrsini re-
tuli, quod Deus benè vertat, cuius gloriæ in-
servire fuit animus. Quòd autem, Generose
Comes, tibi alienos labores consecrare visum
est, non indignè ferent, qui consilii mei ratio-
nes expendere dignabuntur: quarum prior est,
ipsius Vrsini, dum vixit, erga te singularis be-
nevolentia, quæ nobile nomen tuum Theolo-
gicis laboribus, quos reverenter colis, inscri-
bere iubet. Altera, quum doctissimi tui pr-
æceptoris laudabili studio, è scriniis tuis tam
præclarum opus in lucem exeat, quis mihi vi-
tio vertet, si præclarum istud opus, veluti tu-
um tibi vendicem? quod ut dextra manu, &
ceu genuinum Vrsini posthumum accipias,
C.T. vehementer etiam atque etiam rogo. Ge-
nevæ .15. Calend. Aprilis. Anno patientiæ
Addictissimus,
S. G. S.

page.notes: Printed text is in roman type throughout, with a few italic words. "Quòd" carries a grave accent as printed; the "Quod" above it is underlined in the scan. Long s normalised to s. "exceptum.Illo" is printed without a space after the stop. ".15." is printed with a spaced "1 5", read here as 15. The small mark at the bottom centre is uncertain and may be a gathering signature or show-through. No page number is printed.
